title: Upload KYC Documents
subtitle: Complete your verification by uploading the required documents

toast.uploadedDescription: Your {{docType}} has been uploaded and submitted for verification.
toast.failedDescription: Failed to upload document. Please try again.

requirements.title: Document Requirements:
requirements.clear: Documents must be clear and readable

idCard.label: National ID Card
idCard.description: Upload a clear photo of your Namibian ID card. Both front and back sides must be visible and readable.
idCard.instructions: Ensure all text is legible, corners are visible, and there is no glare or shadows.

proofIncome.label: Proof of Income
proofIncome.description: Upload your latest payslip (not older than 3 months) or employment contract.
proofIncome.instructions: Document must show your full name, employer details, and current salary amount.

bankStatement.label: Bank Statement
bankStatement.description: Upload your most recent bank statement (last 3 months) from any Namibian bank.
bankStatement.instructions: Statement must show your name, account details, and transaction history.

employmentLetter.label: Employment Letter
employmentLetter.description: Upload an official letter from your employer confirming your employment status.
employmentLetter.instructions: Letter must be on company letterhead, signed, and dated within the last 30 days.
